glossary.definition: (1) "Pure caffeine product" means, subject to division (A)(2) of this section, a product that consists solely or primarily of caffeine and is manufactured into a crystalline, liquid, or powdered form.
glossary.source_title: Section 2925.34 - Sale of pure caffeine product.
